bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
sha=b4ecd358cdb2f12aeb5d996c4112ce052b017430
git fetch --no-tags origin feat/assistant-ai-and-sales-core >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo STK04_FETCH_FAILED; exit 61; }
test "$(git rev-parse FETCH_HEAD)" = "$sha" || { echo STK04_SOURCE_SHA_MISMATCH; exit 62; }
d="$(mktemp -d /tmp/create-vdo-topic.XXXXXXXX)"
out="$(mktemp /tmp/create-vdo-topic-build.XXXXXXXX)"
trap 'rm -rf "$d";rm -f "$out"' EXIT
git archive "$sha" | tar -xf - -C "$d"
test -f "$d/src/runtime/creatorStickerPinMain.mjs" || { echo STK04_ENTRY_SOURCE_MISSING; exit 63; }
if ! docker build --network host --pull=false -f "$d/deploy/Dockerfile" -t create-videobot:sticker-topic-pin "$d" >"$out" 2>&1;then
 echo STK04_IMAGE_BUILD=FAIL
 grep -Ei 'error|failed|unavailable|network|denied' "$out" | tail -n 8 | sed -E 's#https?://[^ ]+#(URL_REDACTED)#g' || true
 exit 64
fi
echo STK04_IMAGE_BUILD=PASS
docker image inspect create-videobot:sticker-topic-pin >/dev/null
candidates=()
for f in "$PWD"/deploy/secrets/* "$PWD"/deploy/*token* "$HOME"/.config/create-videobot/*; do
 test -f "$f" && test ! -L "$f" || continue
 case "$(basename "$f" | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]')" in *userbot*|*session*|*oauth*|*phone*) continue;; esac
 case "$(basename "$f" | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]')" in *bot*|*token*|*secret*) :;; *) continue;; esac
 mode="$(stat -c '%a' "$f")";size="$(stat -c '%s' "$f")"
 test "$mode" = 600 && test "$size" -ge 35 && test "$size" -le 512 || continue
 candidates+=("$f")
done
test "${#candidates[@]}" -eq 1 || { echo STK04_OWNER_SECRET_CANDIDATE_COUNT_INVALID; exit 65; }
state="$HOME/.local/state/create-videobot/sticker-entry"
mkdir -p "$state";chmod 700 "$state"
export VIDEOBOT_TELEGRAM_TOKEN_SOURCE="${candidates[0]}"
export VIDEOBOT_STICKER_PIN_STATE_SOURCE="$state"
if ! docker compose -f "$d/deploy/compose.videobot.topic-pin.yaml" run --no-build --rm videobot-topic-pin >"$out" 2>&1;then
 echo STK04_CREATOR_ONE_SHOT=FAIL
 grep -E '^(CREATOR_|Error|error)' "$out" | tail -n 8 || true
 exit 66
fi
grep -E '^CREATOR_STICKER_PIN_' "$out" || true
grep -qx 'CREATOR_STICKER_PIN_API_ACK=PASS' "$out" || { echo STK04_API_ACK_MISSING; exit 67; }
echo STK04_CREATOR_OWNED_TOPIC_PIN=PASS
